_about: Display wording only (services/plain_language.py). Questions are keyed by KB question_id, labels by the exact KB option / condition text. No rules here: taps are mapped back to the KB labels before the engine sees them. Questions shown as tick lists (yes/no questions naming 3+ things) use a short heading. Keep 'the person' in question text: it becomes 'you' when the screening is for the user. DRAFT, pending clinical review: PLAIN_LANGUAGE stays off until approved.
